digest.component_or_area: inbound probe dispatch and deletion reconciliation
propositions: The (inbound, probe) dispatch chain has no live producer because differ._compute_mutations_emit_absent_partner_probes expects jira_key in local_state, but run_differs passes a fetched Jira snapshot whose entries carry no jira_key.

A confirmed hard-deleted Jira issue whose local ticket still exists is resurrected after 3 passes when the binding retires, becomes unbound, and outbound_differ emits a create—this resurrects despite operator ruling that deleted issues should never be resurrected.
The dead legacy probe arm and same-pass re-create implementation (c244) must be removed and replaced with a tombstone guard that prevents re-creation of confirmed-deleted pairings.

The deletion-vs-aged-out discrimination is already implemented live in outbound_differ._safe_get_issue and binding_walk.py:187-196, verified on real DC, making the inbound probe arm architecturally redundant.
The suppression of resurrection must be observable via a bridge alert naming the local id, retired jira_key, and BindingStore.unretire() as the route to restore creation.
